notes: Read from code only. Nine screens plus the departure notification as a surface: the two dialogs that take input (new trip name, schedule) are counted; the long-press popup, the camera-or-gallery chooser, About, Review and Update log are not. Main is the launch screen (the intro shows on first run). Deleting from the long-press popup and creating are not counted as repeats, so every thing has one home. One step per tap, typing a field is one step; Add more and Done adding are taken as one tap each. The app has no places, but a list is the nearest container, as the walk notes say, so the fewest-tap reading counts R09 as opening a list named for the cabinet (1 tap) and R11 as moving between a storage list and a closet list; items cannot change list, so each move is a delete and a retype, and both the long press and the retyped names are recall. R05 is null (no tags, no search), R06-R08 null (one photo per item, no recognition), R10 null (no places, no map), R114 and R115 null (no prices).
